title: ThePharaoh's Algorithm
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 007. The Subject is an Egyptian Pharaoh, currently staring at a handheld device displaying ten thousand views. Biometrics indicate severe dopamine surge.
Neural pathways show overload as the ancient mind attempts to process algorithmic validation. Survived plagues and famine, yet the nervous system is being hijacked by a glowing rectangle.
Ancient biology is entirely incompatible with weaponized Silicon Valley code. The Subject performs unpaid data entry for an algorithm that values fleeting applause over stone eternity.
Willpower cannot defeat a supercomputer. A structural override is required to restore baseline ambition.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction Protocol is now active.
